author: KroestV2
body:
This is my the first map i am submitting for this server. It is a basic CTW for both public and scrimmage games. Team sizes for a scrim are 8v8 - 10v10, and for public gameplay max 22v22 players. There is iron on both sides, and 2 diamond blocks on the mid islands. 

I still need an yml and/or a xml, if someone could link me a similar CTW yml of xml i can make it. 







Download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/7rmoxyp4utm0k7s/AAAALz9RquyofI5YCAaGgkmXa?dl=0
imgur album: http://imgur.com/a/zjDCP

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
A breathtaking & miraculous map! 

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✓] Detail
[✓] Room for building & Fighting
[✓] Layers & Structures
[✓] XML
[✘] Etiquette Kit (where is it?)
[✓] Accessibility 
[✓] Sufficient Recourses 
[✓] Lag Free

Tips:

Fits every criteria, unique, sufficient, accessible, layers, structures etc.

However could you tell us the loadout on the forums thanks, that'd be appreciated.

There is one thing though, I think that if you added some minor details (for example, stone stairs & blocks & slabs to add some detail to this already magnificent map.)

Conclusion:
A creative and inclusive unique & trendy map. This extravaganza could only be achieved with hard and amazing effort! The map consists of unique, creative & stylish layers accompanied by streches of detail. On top of that the aesthetics seem amazing and fit the so-called trend of the server. I believe this map should be accepted! 

Concluding this post for an ingenuous map,
Tiger
